passages.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
We do not deserve glory.
We do not seek honor for ourselves.
Give glory to Your name, O LORD.
You show loving devotion.
You are faithful.
Your name deserves all honor.
passages.original: לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־ לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־ חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־ אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
passages.sermon:
The nations are people who do not worship the Lord.
They ask a question about God's presence.
They say, "Where is their God?"
They wonder why God is not visible to them.
They doubt the presence of the God of Israel.
passages.original: לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה־ נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
passages.sermon:
Our God is in heaven.
He does whatever He wants.
He has all power.
He acts according to His will.
No one can stop Him.
He is not like idols made by people.
He is alive and active.
He rules over everything.
passages.original: וֵֽאלֹהֵ֥ינוּ בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־ חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
passages.sermon:
The nations make idols.
These idols are silver and gold.
People use their own hands to make these idols.
These idols do not come from God.
People create them.
passages.original: עֲ‍ֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see; they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell; they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
passages.sermon:
Idols are objects made by people.
Idols have mouths.
Idols cannot speak.
Idols have eyes.
Idols cannot see.
Idols have ears.
Idols cannot hear.
Idols have noses.
Idols cannot smell.
Idols have hands.
Idols cannot feel.
Idols have feet.
Idols cannot walk.
Idols cannot make a sound in their throats.
passages.original: פֶּֽה־ לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃ אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃ יְדֵיהֶ֤ם׀ וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא־ יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃

passages.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
passages.sermon:
Idols are lifeless objects.
People make these idols.
People who make idols become like the idols.
People who trust in idols also become like the idols.
Idols cannot speak, see, hear, smell, feel, or walk.
People who depend on idols become just as powerless and lifeless as the idols.
passages.original: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
passages.sermon:
Israel is a nation chosen by God.
Israel, trust in the LORD.
The LORD helps Israel.
The LORD protects Israel.
passages.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

passages.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
passages.sermon:
The house of Aaron includes the priests of Israel.
The house of Aaron must trust in the LORD.
The LORD helps the house of Aaron.
The LORD protects the house of Aaron.
The LORD is their shield.
passages.original: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

passages.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
passages.sermon:
Those who fear the LORD must trust in the LORD.
The LORD helps them.
The LORD protects them.
The LORD is their shield.
passages.original: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖ם וּמָגִנָּ֣ם הֽוּא׃

passages.text: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron; He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
passages.sermon:
The LORD remembers us.
The LORD will bless us.
The LORD will bless the house of Israel.
The LORD will bless the house of Aaron.
The LORD will bless all who fear Him.
He will bless both the small and the great.
passages.original: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן׃ יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם־ הַגְּדֹלִֽים׃

passages.text: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gives blessings.
The LORD can give you increase.
The LORD can give your children increase.
May the LORD increase you.
May the LORD increase your children.
passages.original: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם וְעַל־ בְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD made heaven and earth.
He is the Maker of all things.
May the LORD bless you.
You are blessed by the LORD.
passages.original: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַיהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
passages.sermon:
The LORD owns the highest heavens.
The LORD made the heavens for Himself.
The LORD gave the earth to mankind.
God gave the earth to human beings.
passages.original: הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הָאָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִבְנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
passages.sermon: The dead do not praise the LORD.\r\nPeople who go down to silence do not praise the LORD.
passages.original: לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ־ יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל־ יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה׃

passages.text: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
We are people who live on the earth.
God gave the earth to us.
We will bless the LORD.
We will do this now.
We will bless the LORD forever.
Praise the LORD.
passages.original: וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ׀ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽעַתָּ֥ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
